title: Advanced Professional Certificate In Contemporary Issues And Principles Of Marketing
description: Delve into the dynamic landscape of marketing with a focus on contemporary issues and principles.
longDescription: This comprehensive course explores fundamental marketing concepts, the intricacies of the marketing mix, extended marketing strategies, and the impact of external and internal environments on market planning. Participants will gain insights into contemporary marketing issues and learn to develop effective marketing plans and strategies.
courseDetails: Define and explain the concept of the marketing mix. Define and elaborate on each of the Four P's: Product, Price, Place, and Promotion. Explore how the Four P's relate to different stages of the product life cycle. Examine how marketing decisions impact the product itself, including features, design, and branding. Evaluate how marketing strategies affect pricing decisions, such as setting initial prices, discounts, and pricing adjustments. Define the concept of the supply chain and its significance in marketing. Analyze how efficient supply chain management can impact product availability, distribution, and customer satisfaction. Define integrated marketing communication (IMC) and its role in modern marketing. Examine the components of IMC, including advertising, public relations, sales promotion, personal selling, and digital marketing. Understand the Extended Marketing Mix. Explore the Marketing Process and Its Elements. Master Marketing Mix Planning. Identify Types of Business Processes. Comprehend Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). Enhance Consistency in Customer Service through People and Customer Interface. Discover Qualities of an Effective Customer Service Representative. Develop the ability to define and understand the components of the marketing environment. Acquire knowledge and skills related to implementing innovation in marketing strategies. Gain proficiency in conducting PESTLE analysis to assess external factors influencing business environments. Understand and apply the BCG matrix for strategic analysis of a product or business portfolio. Develop a comprehensive understanding of Porter’s Five Forces model for analyzing industry competitiveness. Explore the role of marketing in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. Familiarize yourself with McKinsey’s Seven S Model for organizational analysis and strategic planning. Demonstrating Proficiency in Developing a Comprehensive Marketing Plan. Analysing the Components of Marketing Planning. Understanding the Strategic Marketing Planning Process. Evaluating Distribution Strategies for Products and Services. Synthesize Marketing Planning and Marketing Strategy. Participants will dive into fundamental marketing principles, differentiate between customer needs, wants, and desires, and explore current and future marketing trends. The course delves into the marketing mix, extended marketing strategies, and the role of marketing in addressing external and internal environmental factors. Participants will also master marketing planning, strategy development, and distribution strategies. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Fundamental Concepts in Marketing: Understanding the Marketing Mix: Understanding the Extended Marketing Mix: External and Internal Environment for Designing a Market Plan: Marketing Planning and Strategy:
